scope: Physics feedback gating, quality-admitted physical Teacher distillation, multi-step supervision and evidence-based LLM tuning interfaces.
working_tree: Local uncommitted changes; no push performed in this repair.

changes.gate: New K1 runs use bounded mode with feedback_floor=0.1. Mean calibrated ID information replaces worst-dimension squared attenuation. Same computation in collection, PPO replay and inference; zero-init, action bounds and publication KL checks retained.
changes.teacher: Objective v2 removes latent-coordinate MSE and parameter-copy supervision. Five normalized state groups plus contact BCE; separate training/Teacher-validation/calibration regions. EMA physical targets require improvement over Student and persistence and an executed-vs-permuted action diagnostic.
changes.multistep: New K1 Dynamics defaults to horizons (1,4); 0.1 times normalized group MSE supervises recorded ordered executed actions, excluding reset and reserved-data crossings.
changes.advisor: Ordered trends, anonymous per-clip fixed errors and separate failures/completions. Curriculum changes require evidence. Independent-Adam global loss multipliers replaced with actual critic/Teacher optimizer rates, saved and restored. Latest per-iteration snapshot used by offline requests.

tests_confirm: Uninformative ID: calibrated gate gives zero residual PPO update; bounded gate gives nonzero gradient and update.
Collection/recomputed policy parity; standalone full-policy frozen evaluation; old calibrated and legacy checkpoint behavior.
Rejected/insufficient/action-insensitive Teachers cannot distill; admitted physical targets reach the Student optimizer; latent coordinate changes do not change v2 distillation.
Validation and calibration labels excluded from optimizer targets; stopped Teacher gradients; masked/rejected NaNs do not poison Student gradients.
Four-step prediction heads receive gradients and reject reset-crossing windows.
Opposite metric trends or swapped clip difficulty produce different requests; names and paths excluded from numeric evidence.
Missing per-clip evidence rejects curriculum changes; provider errors and proposal budgets fail without parameter changes.
A 25 percent critic learning-rate increase changes actual same-batch update norm by approximately 25 percent; optimizer rates survive checkpoint restore.

synthetic_learning.meaning: Constructed learning counterexamples using production network modules; NOT robot tracking accuracy, PPO locomotion convergence or GPU throughput.

not_verified: Real DeepSeek/GLM API requests (no credentials used).
Real CUDA/mjlab/MuJoCo robot training: dependencies and CUDA unavailable locally.
Multi-seed robot-control gains, sim2real, skateboard dynamics, motion-specific sliding rewards, leaderboard ranking or wall-clock advantage.
limitations: Feedback floor is a design budget, not confidence or a safety guarantee.
Teacher admission uses correlated temporal holdout samples and heuristic thresholds, not independent-domain generalization evidence.
Privileged information can remain unidentifiable to the Student; predictive distillation does not create missing observations.
Four-step auxiliary direct prediction is not a long-horizon world model.
LLM candidates still require explicit matched experiments; no automatic promotion.
